release_notes_zh:
v0.5.2 中文界面与启动行为修复版：
- 默认界面语言改为中文；补齐 Qt 标准按钮（确定/取消/关闭、向导按钮）中文翻译，安装版不再因缺翻译文件显示英文
- 修复插件管理器、模型管理、偏好设置等界面显示英文键名的问题；验证报告、AASM 规则、自定义绘图等对话框文案中文化
- 行为标签在波形标注框、右键菜单、趋势表、图表图例中显示中文名（运动/理毛/嗅探/平静呼吸/睡眠），数据键保持英文以兼容模型与导入导出
- 启动引导只自动显示一次：无需勾选「不再显示」，之后启动不再弹出；帮助菜单可随时手动重新打开
- 新版本更新提示同一版本只自动弹出一次（手动「检查更新」不受限）
- 修复保存偏好设置后启动引导再次弹出（隐藏标记被重置）
- Excel 附加表样式改为共享样式数组：25h 每秒表建表约 7.4 倍加速、峰值内存约降 198MB，导出内容逐字节不变
- 呼吸标志比对改二分定位、指纹重采样分块、导出线程低优先级并让出 GIL：长录音导出更快、界面更流畅
- 修复打开 MKT 文件后选区标注无法导出（行为导出/全部数据导出菜单恒灰）
- 修复「全部数据」导出在默认设置下缺少「呼吸指标_每秒/_每分钟」两表
- 安装版可直接覆盖 0.5.1（同 AppId，保留用户设置）
release_notes_en:
v0.5.2 (Chinese UI and startup behavior fix release):
- Default UI language is now Chinese; Qt standard buttons (OK/Cancel/Close, wizard buttons) are translated in the installed build
- Fixed English key names shown in the plugin manager, model manager and preferences; localized validation report, AASM rules and custom plot dialogs
- The welcome guide is shown automatically only once; no checkbox needed, and it can be reopened from the Help menu
- The update-available dialog is shown automatically only once per version
- Saving preferences no longer re-enables the welcome guide
- Excel extra-sheet styling now shares style arrays: ~7.4x faster build for the 25h per-second sheet and ~198MB lower peak memory, with byte-identical output
- Faster sigh matching, chunked fingerprint resampling, low-priority export thread with GIL yields: faster long-recording exports and smoother UI
- Fixed the export menu staying disabled after annotating an MKT selection
- Fixed the all-data export missing the per-second/per-minute respiratory sheets with default settings
- The setup upgrades 0.5.1 in place, keeping user settings
